paragraphs: Start by installing fixtures and running cables, then program cues from the script. During rehearsal, operate lights and calibrate color temperature with the director and cinematographer. Monitor the show from the console and improvise changes when needed. Afterward, dismantle and store equipment and record wear; film work also requires fill lighting around camera positions.

In short, they turn a live venue into precisely lit imagery. Work includes installing fixtures, operating consoles, dimming, calibrating color temperature, emergency response, and following the action. It combines technical judgment and hands-on work as the production's lighting specialist.

subject.summary: Lighting technicians are the directors of light on site, integrating fixtures, consoles, and cue sheets into precisely timed light and shadow. One incorrect color-temperature setting can muddy the image.
